title: Finch Circle Members and the Price Accuracy Promise — Accuracy Share Schedule (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
On a Price Accuracy Promise correction of a Merchandise Purchases unit, the accuracy share — the percentage of the shelf overcharge credited to the customer — is set by the customer's membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program and by whether the Finch Circle number was captured on the transaction.

| Finch Circle Loyalty Program records | Finch Circle number captured on the transaction (purchase record) | Accuracy share |
|---|---|---|
| active membership at the Platinum, Diamond or Icon tier | Yes | premium accuracy share, 50 percent |
| active membership at the Silver or Gold tier | Yes | member accuracy share, 35 percent |

Both parts of a row must hold. A customer who meets neither row is outside this schedule.

## Combinations

| Membership on record | Number captured | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Icon, active | Yes | 50 percent |
| Diamond, active | No | outside this schedule |
| Gold, active | Yes | 35 percent |
| Silver, active | No | outside this schedule |
| Member tier, active | Yes | outside this schedule |
| no active membership | Yes | outside this schedule |

## Hypothetical figures

On a shelf overcharge of $10.00, the premium share credits $5.00 and the member share $3.50.
